verdict.rationale: Kitty documents a programmable remote-control interface and terminal protocols, and a hands-on probe confirmed the control loop works. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning, compatibility guarantees or a deprecation policy. The axis applies because kitty's remote-control and graphics protocols are APIs that could be versioned, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
